title: Advance six-node tracks atomically and terminate exact win conditions
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Apply one canonical operation result once: Repair increments Repair by1, Sabotage increments Sabotage by1, Anomaly advances neither. Enforce0–6 tracks and record the exact semantic node event from MOMENT-SPEC. R6 City Restored ends immediately in ARCHIVISTS_WIN; S6 City Lost ends immediately in STATIC_WIN. Do not retain five-point legacy/demo logic or infer outcomes from alignment. Terminal states reject subsequent scoring; Null Disconnect victory is supplied by the dedicated reducer and cannot be overwritten.
acceptance: Every node R1–R6/S1–S6 emits its matching semantic identity once, not just a score delta.
The two six-point thresholds yield the exact canonical winner immediately; Anomaly never advances either track.
Replayed results, invalid bounds and post-terminal effects cannot duplicate a node or replace a declared winner.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
